# Microsoft 2025 Environmental Sustainability Report (FY24)

## Key Findings (recovered via Exa PDF fetch + secondary sources)

### Carbon
- Total emissions (Scope 1, 2, 3) increased 23.4% vs 2020 baseline due to AI and cloud expansion.
- Scope 1 and 2 emissions decreased 29.9% from 2020 baseline in FY24.
- Scope 3 emissions increased 26% from 2020 baseline in FY24.
- Contracted 34 GW of carbon-free electricity across 24 countries (~18x increase since 2020).
- Entered long-term agreements to procure nearly 30 million metric tons of carbon removal.
- Energy use increased 168% and revenue grew 71% over same 2020-2024 period.

### Water
- Met target to provide >1.5 million people with clean water and sanitation solutions.
- On track to replenish more water than consumed across global operations.
- New datacenter design consumes zero water for cooling, avoiding ~125,000 cubic meters annually per facility.
- FY24 water withdrawals: 10,377 ML; water consumption: 5,807 ML.
- FY24 water withdrawals from water-stressed areas: 4,747 ML (46% of total).
- Transitioning from air-cooled to chip-level liquid cooling at all owned datacenters.

### Datacenter Construction
- Launched first mass timber datacenters in FY24 (hybrid CLT + steel + concrete).
- Mass timber projected to reduce embodied carbon by 35% vs conventional steel, 65% vs precast concrete.
- Doubled rate of power savings via power harvesting.

### 2030 Goals
- Carbon negative, water positive, zero waste, protect ecosystems.
